questions.q: What does a page layout control on a record?
options: Only which users can log in
The full record page: fields, sections, related lists, and action buttons
questions.explain: A page layout controls the entire record page — every field, section, related list, and button.

questions.q: What is the maximum number of fields a compact layout can include?
questions.explain: A compact layout is capped at 10 fields, shown in priority order.

questions.q: Which of these is powered by the compact layout, not the page layout?
options: The Related tab's list of child records
The highlights panel, mobile record view, and hover cards
The page's action buttons like Edit and Follow
questions.explain: The highlights panel, mobile view, and hover cards are all powered by the compact layout's short field list.

questions.q: A field was added to the Account page layout, but doesn't appear when hovering an Account link from a Contact. What's the likely cause?
options: Page layouts can't include new fields
Hover cards always show every field automatically
The field needs to be deleted and recreated
The field also needs to be added to the Account's compact layout
questions.explain: Hover cards are powered by the compact layout, not the page layout — adding a field to the page layout alone won't make it appear there.

questions.q: Per this lesson, what is the single most common mistake with these two tools?
options: Assuming the two tools control the same thing, when they're configured separately and do different jobs
Forgetting to activate a page layout
questions.explain: The lesson calls out confusing which tool controls what as the single most common Platform App Builder exam mistake.
